notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: We fixed a bug that was keeping new players from starting the game, we are really sorry for the inconvenience and hope you will still play the game :D

notes.title: Bug Fixes and new Animations!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
Hel Card doesn't crash anymore
Hel, Izanami and Odin's skills have been fixed, allowing only the right mythology to be activated.
Online Menu crash fixed
Sounds not going below 100% fixed


Improvements:
Revamped and revisted all card animations to give a better experience in the duels
